goal: 在 E 维度新建第五个 Theme E.5「服饰改制与族群身份」与 E.5.1–E.5.2 两个 Topic，把胡服、胡服骑射、孝文改制、孝明帝服饰改革、孝文帝迁都洛阳 5 个 KU 按“改制方向 × 正当性依据”集中挂载。
unresolved: Hu dress and the Hufu Qishe reform: no year, no edict, no scope of implementation; the Hu garment is described only as short jacket, trousers and boots, with no cut, fabric, pattern or excavated object
Belt hook (gouluodai): no object, date, dimension or archaeological evidence; no source states whether it entered with the Hu garment or was a Central-Plains innovation
The objections of the Zhao nobility are not recorded; the source only summarizes that the king 'overcame all objections' and 'persuaded the nobles'
The Shiji Zhao Shijia quotation survives as three sentences with no chapter, section, edition or context; the library does not infer beyond it
Xiaowen reform: no edict, no dress-code detail, no implementation scope; 'the whole court wore Han-Wei garments' is a single summarizing sentence
Xiaomingdi dress reform: no year, no edict text, no scope; what 'Wei law' refers to in 'ritual and ceremonial dress all follow Wei law' is unspecified

Luoyang Qielan Ji (Chengdong) and Nan Qi Shu (Wei Lu Zhuan) are quoted from different sources; no source reads them against each other, so whether 'wide sleeves and broad belts reaching Moling' and 'cage cap over trousers with red robe' are complementary or contradictory is unresolved
Xiaowen's move to Luoyang: no year, edict, opposition or capital layout; the relation between the move and the dress reform is not discussed by any source
No source text links the two Northern Wei reforms causally; whether Xiaomingdi's reform answered the hybrid style that followed Xiaowen's is not established
'Sino-barbarian hybridity' is one description of one style, not a statement about Northern Wei dress as a whole
The 'progressive significance of Northern Wei sinicization' is the source's evaluation, not this Theme's judgment; neither sinicization nor barbarization is treated as a direction of progress
Modern women's dress (qipao, short jacket with skirt, shishi zhuang) and the natural-foot movement remain unmounted and require a separate Theme on gender and the body
Periodization events (An Lushan Rebellion, Jingkang Incident, Pangeng's move to Yin, Pangeng) remain unmounted; whether they belong to dimension E at all is still undecided
2363 KUs remain unmounted; E.5 covers only 5 KUs and E dimension still has 8 unmounted candidates
notes: 本批新建 1 个 Theme（E.5）与 2 个 Topic（E.5.1–E.5.2），挂载 5 个 KU：胡服以 term_anchor、胡服骑射以 evidence_event 入 E.5.1；孝文改制与孝明帝服饰改革以 evidence_event、孝文帝迁都洛阳以 historical_context 入 E.5.2。E.5 按“改制方向 × 正当性依据”分层：胡服骑射为中原向游牧方向改制、依据“便用”，北魏两次改制为鲜卑向中原方向改制、依据“华典”与“魏法”，方向相反而同属“服饰可被政治裁定”的动作。孝文帝迁都以 historical_context 挂载，只为改制提供政治地理背景，不构成改制证据链的一环。E.5 不把“汉化”预设为进步方向，也不把“胡汉杂糅”当作北魏服饰整体状况。近代女装与天足运动因涉及性别与身体，另立 Theme 而不并入 E.5。v1.8 归档哈希 bd363b9a0172e894eccc3a1ecdfc091bfc2d54cb28dc183d1c2612774e85c406 与 h17 apply-plan 记录的 v1.8 索引哈希一致，确认归档无损。未新增 KU、claim、candidate 或来源字节，未改写 03基础书籍-md文档/ 与 02-sources/，未执行 commit 或 push。
